headline: A2O LITE's agency: Vora had surgery for appendicitis
sub: She will sit out scheduled activities to focus on recovery
source: Source: Official statement from A2O Entertainment
caption:
A2O LITE's Vora has undergone surgery for acute appendicitis, her agency says.

On Nov 19, A2O Entertainment announced that Vora went to the hospital after sudden abdominal pain and was diagnosed with acute appendicitis. She had surgery and will skip her scheduled activities, including a pre-recording, to focus on recovery. Wishing her a speedy recovery!

📌 Source: Official statement from A2O Entertainment (via Korean media)
